guarantees.claim: When phase_sel_i equals MuBi4False, state_out is assigned phase1_out.
When phase_sel_i equals MuBi4True, state_out is assigned phase2_out.
If phase_sel_i does not match MuBi4False or MuBi4True, state_out is assigned phase1_out via the default branch.

assumptions.claim: phase_sel_i is driven to a valid, stable encoding of MuBi4False or MuBi4True, not X, Z, or metastable.
assumptions.risk: An invalid or glitching phase_sel_i may hit the default branch and force state_out to phase1_out, potentially exposing one share of the masked Keccak state or causing incorrect round output.

uncertain_points.claim: The default branch selects phase1_out when phase_sel_i is neither MuBi4False nor MuBi4True. It is unknown whether this fallback is a safe quiescent state or could inadvertently output a masked share under illegal or X conditions.
uncertain_points.risk: Leakage of one share of the Keccak state if phase1_out holds secret-dependent data and the fallback is exercised.

uncertain_points.claim: The enum type of phase_sel_i is not defined locally. If it contains legal values beyond MuBi4False and MuBi4True, they will resolve to the default assignment to phase1_out, which may not be the intended mapping.
uncertain_points.cond: phase_sel_i takes other legal enum values
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect state selection, leading to wrong intermediate values in the Keccak permutation.
